messages:
Ava: Quick copy + a11y check for the Deployments empty state. Current header 'No active deployments' feels flat. Want a version that's helpful and scannable.

Jon: Agree. Empty states should sell the outcome, not the task. Maybe 'No deployments yet' + one-liner value prop.

Priya: Draft: Header 'No deployments yet' Body 'Deploy a model to serve low-latency inference to your app.' CTA: 'Create deployment' Secondary: 'Deployment guide'

Ava: +1 on that. Tiny nit: 'to your app' might be ambiguous for org-level users. How about 'for your product' or just drop it: 'Deploy a model to serve low-latency inference.'

Kim: Accessibility: ensure the decorative illustration has empty alt and we keep the explanatory body as real text. Also add aria-describedby linking the CTA to the body text for screen reader context.

DesignBot: Tone check: keep sentences short for localization. Suggest body: 'Deploy a model to serve low-latency inference.' Tooltip for the button should read 'Create a deployment' not just 'Create'. Ensure the primary button contrast ratio meets AA.

Priya: Updated strings for engineers/components: Header: "No deployments yet" Body: "Deploy a model to serve low-latency inference." Primary CTA: "Create deployment" Secondary CTA: "Deployment guide" Button tooltip: "Create a deployment" Helper (monospace): "Prefer CLI? Try `redwood deploy`"

Jon: +1. One more UX nit: make the primary CTA focused by default when empty state is visible, so keyboard users can act quickly. Add that to the component spec.

Ava: Great. I'll update the Figma component copy and add the ARIA notes in the spec doc, then open a small PR with the strings. Tagging @Product for localization review.

Kim: Thanks! :thumbsup:
